thread:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: prompt-router v2.4 -> 10% in us-west1 (pr-v2-*). Canary window: 15m. Rollout ID: r-2026-03-15-01

oncall-maria: seeing p95 jump to ~1.2s at 10:46 UTC, traffic looks fine but error rate creeping up

ashok: getting paged for 502s from the canary hosts, grabbed some logs. Anyone seeing customer impact?

support-lin: Support: 3 customers reported failed completions since 10:47 (Acme Analytics, BrightForms, SimpleQ). They see 502/503 intermittently. Tickets linked: TKT-9812, TKT-9813

incident-bot: [INCIDENT CREATED] sev:2 | affected-service: prompt-router | symptom: elevated 5xx rate (4.5%) | triggered-by: canary-alert | paging oncall-maria :rotating_light:

oncall-maria: on it, pulling recent canary logs. If error rate stays >1% for 5m we'll escalate to SRE.

sre-jake: coming in. Can you paste the trace and a small sample of the error? Also check the feature flag state for prompt_router_v2.

ashok: logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T10:47:12Z] ERROR prompt-router request_id=xyz status=502 upstream_error=\"kv-cache-index-mismatch\" host=pr-v2-07
[2026-03-15T10:47:13Z] ERROR prompt-router request_id=abc status=503 downstream_timeout model=bert-quant
```

ashok: flag check: `curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FF_API_TOKEN\" https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/prompt_router_v2` -> `{ \"enabled\": true, \"rollout\": 0.10 }`

product-sophia: this is the experimental prompt routing endpoint we rolled for lower latency — if it's failing we should stop the canary and snap back to the old route ASAP. Customer impact > 2 tenants is bad.

oncall-maria: Agreed. Two possible mitigations: 1) Abort rollout (stop traffic to v2 canary) 2) Kill feature flag (turn off routing to v2 globally). Prefer stop canary first to limit blast radius. Thoughts?

ashok: stop canary sounds good, but UI takes ~90s to reconfigure. Kill-flag is immediate. Risk: kill-flag could affect other regions if mis-scoped. We need to confirm scope.

sre-jake: If the flag is global and we kill it we restore traffic immediately. If the rollout is only 10% we could also scale down pr-v2 instances to 0 to cut traffic. What's fastest?

ashok: fastest is flag toggle. I'll run the safe kill which targets routing for prompt-router only in us-west1. Command: ```bash
curl -X POST \"https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/prompt_router_v2/toggle\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FF_API_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"enabled":false, "scope": {"region":"us-west1"}, "reason":"canary 5xx spike"}'
```

support-lin: FYI ops: notify the three affected customers that we're taking emergency action. I'll draft a short note.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-15-01 detected stop request. Initiating canary abort sequence. Traffic will return to previous routing within ~30s.

ashok: toggled flag -> command returned 202 Accepted. API response: `{ \"flag\": \"prompt_router_v2\", \"enabled\": false, \"scope\": { \"region\": \"us-west1\" }, \"changed_by\": \"ashok\", \"time\": \"2026-03-15T10:48:05Z\" }`

sre-jake: monitoring metrics... error rate falling. p95 back to baseline in ~40s. No new 5xx spikes after 10:49. Good catch.

oncall-maria: Excellent. Flag kill confirmed. Incident-bot: set status -> \"mitigated\", de-escalate paging.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT UPDATE] status=mitigated | mitigation=ff-toggle(us-west1) | time=2026-03-15T10:49:30Z | owner=oncall-maria

product-sophia: We still need a root cause: kv-cache-index-mismatch in logs — maybe a model artifact mismatch with v2 path. Please create a postmortem and include canary traffic characteristics + model version pinning checks.

ashok: I'll grab the failing artifacts and run a repro in staging. Also will check kernel selection and quantization flags used by v2 path.

support-lin: Sent short customer updates to the three tenants: \"We've reverted the experimental routing; we're investigating. No data exposure; we'll follow up with timeline.\"

sre-jake: Action items: 1) ashok: repro + artifact diff (ETA 2h) 2) maria: run canary analysis & confirm scope of impacted requests (ETA 1h) 3) product/sophia: decide next rollout gating (postmortem to include extra gate)

oncall-maria: Handoff note: I'll stay on for the next 30m then hand to oncall rotation if needed. If any regressions pop up re-open incident.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-15-01 status: aborted. Canary hosts drained.

incident-bot: Incident closed -> status: monitoring. Please populate the incident doc: /incidents/1849123672-canary-latency-surge-ff-snapback.

sre-jake: Adding one quick log excerpt for the postmortem: ```
[2026-03-15T10:47:12Z] WARN kv-cache index mismatch: expected 0x1a got 0x2f for model=bert-quant, falling back -> increased latency and some timeouts
```

support-lin: reopening tickets with update. Will attach timeline once postmortem posted.

product-sophia: Thanks all. We'll review rollout gating for experimental routing end-to-end (model compatibility + kernel checks) before next attempt.

oncall-maria: closing thread for now — will update incident doc with timeline and link to repro. :white_check_mark:
